motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Existing button color feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-primary{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;background:var(--action,#543391);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--action,#543391);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease-out;}.ds-primary:hover{background:#412573;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #7958b5;outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-label{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;display:block;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink,#242132);}.ds-input{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;display:block;margin-top:6px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#242132);border:1px solid #aaa3bb;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;caret-color:var(--action,#543391);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #7958b5;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Current navigation
components.html: 내 작업
components.css: .ds-current{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;display:block;padding:9px 12px;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;background:#e4dced;color:#40236f;}.ds-current:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #7958b5;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-current:hover{background:#e4dced;color:#40236f;}

components.name: Supporting container
components.css: .ds-support{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#242132);border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd9e6);border-radius:8px;padding:24px;background:white;}

components.name: Empty state
components.css: .ds-empty{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;padding:40px 24px;background:#f7f6fa;color:var(--muted,#625d73);}

components.name: Record row
components.css: .ds-row{font:15px/1.65 "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#ddd9e6);color:var(--ink,#242132);}.ds-row p{color:var(--muted,#625d73);}

narrative.overview: White work surfaces, a pale violet sidebar and deep violet actions organize recruitment and team work. Project rows prioritize titles, roles and remaining capacity; the work panel keeps personal tasks close. State and role changes belong to the task content rather than decorative charts.
donts: Do not imply production success from synthetic state.
Do not claim visual verification without rendering.
